chat.author: David Benjamin

@Christopher Patton The current naming constellation is:

Embedded alternate issuer certificate (what a mouthful :sob: ): the gross two-issuers-in-one certificate construction
Turduckens: the fun name for the above
Post-quantum opt-out certificate: Using a PQ CA to sign a classical EE, the use case for turduckens

We're going to use embedded alternate issuers to embed a PQ opt-out into a classical cert. But I think splitting hairs is only really useful when we write down the specs. The useful term to tell everyone else is "PQ opt-out certificate". The fun term to use among ourselves is "turducken".
